# gtropic

## Overview

The R package `gtropic` provides a retrieval, filtering, and plotting
client for the live G-TROPIC collection of tropical cyclone exposure
datasets, published and updated weekly on Harvard Dataverse. Exposure
datasets include wind, precipitation, and flooding data at second-level
administrative unit (ADM2) resolution for every ADM2 and International
Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) recorded storm
globally, from 1980 to the present. Key features include:

- A cornerstone query function:
  [`gtropic_data()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_data.md)
- Discovery helpers for exploring the available vocabulary of
  administrative units and storms
- Version manifests for reproducible re-retrieval
- An on-disk cache enabled by default, with per-call bypass controls
- Publication-ready static and interactive plots

## Installation

The development version of `gtropic` can be installed from GitHub with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("sparklabnyc/gtropic")
```

`gtropic` can then be loaded and attached in your current R session as
usual with:

``` r

library(gtropic)
```

## Usage

``` r

library(gtropic)

# Grab exposure data for Hurricane Katrina (2005)
katrina <- gtropic_data(STORM_NAME = "Katrina-2005")
#> Discovering datasets in collection "gtropic".
#> Retrieving 0 files (0.0 B) ; 10 already cached.
summary(katrina)
#> 
#> ── G-TROPIC data summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> 
#> ── Sources ──
#> 
#> • Server: "demo.dataverse.org"
#> • Historical dataset: doi:10.70122/FK2/SWEYST v4.0
#> • Files retrieved: 10 (143.0 MB)
#> • Retrieved at: 2026-10-30 22:53:30 UTC
#> 
#> ── Tables ──
#> 
#> • wind: 1477 rows x 12 columns
#> • precip: 5908 rows x 3 columns
#> • flood: 237 rows x 7 columns
#> • zero_pairs: 39531 rows x 5 columns
#> • tracks: 64 rows x 10 columns
#> • pop: 1477 rows x 6 columns
#> • storm_metadata: 1 rows x 4 columns
#> • adm2: 1477 rows x 5 columns
#> • geometry: 1477 rows x 2 columns
#> • codebook: 7 entries (list)
#> • links: 1477 rows x 12 columns
#> 
#> ── Resolved filters ──
#> 
#> • ADM2 units: 1477
#> • Storms: 1
#> • Wind radius: 500 km
#> • Precipitation window: -2/ +1 days within 500 km
#> • Flood window: -2/+1 days within 500 km (match: "start")
```

The
[`gtropic_data()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_data.md)
function returns a named list of tables that by default includes:

- **`wind`** – one row per administrative unit per storm, for pairs
  where wind exposure was non-zero. This is the core exposure table.
- **`precip`** – one row per administrative unit per local calendar
  date, for dates falling near a storm’s passage for that ADM2.
- **`flood`** – one row per observed flood event.
- **`pop`** – population and population-weighted centroid data, per ADM2
  per year.
- **`adm2`** – the lookup table of administrative units.
- **`codebook`** – the dataset’s own documentation, as a nested list.
- **`zero_pairs`** – administrative unit-storm pairs with no measurable
  wind.
- **`tracks`** – raw storm-track observations.
- **`geometry`** – administrative boundaries, as an `sf` object.
- **`storm_metadata`** – storm names, identifiers, and genesis dates.
- **`links`** – see below.

Pass a shorter `tables` vector when you do not need every table and want
to reduce transfer and storage requirements. The default includes
`geometry`, so it requires the suggested `sf` and `sfarrow` packages.

By default, `wind_radius_km = 500` retains returned `wind` records and
`links` whose published `STORM_DIST_KM` is at or below 500 km,
inclusively. Set it to `Inf` or `NULL` for no wind-distance bound. The
precipitation and flood radii remain independent, but their windows are
evaluated only for links retained by the wind-radius filter.

Every result also carries a **manifest** providing a record of which
published files went into the result, including their paths, dataset
versions, sizes and checksums. Saving it lets you reproduce the same
retrieval months later, even if the dataset has since been revised.

``` r

saveRDS(gtropic_manifest(usa_05), "usa-2005-manifest.rds")
```

## Plotting

``` r

gtropic_plot(katrina)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-6-1.png)

``` r

# Grab exposure data for Hurricane Helene (2024)
helene <- gtropic_data(STORM_NAME = "Helene-2024")
#> Discovering datasets in collection "gtropic".
#> Retrieving 0 files (0.0 B) ; 10 already cached.

# Plot Helene's exposure data
gtropic_plot(helene)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-7-1.png)

See
[`vignette("plotting")`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/articles/plotting.md)
for vectorized multi-metric maps, Saffir-Simpson track keys, gridlines,
interactive maps, thresholds, and more.

## Getting help

Extensive documentation is available on our pkgdown website as well as
offline within R. You can see the `gtropic` reference manual in R with:

``` r

help("gtropic")
```

A number of vignettes are available and can be browsed in R using:

``` r

browseVignettes("gtropic")
```

We recommend reading the vignettes in the following order:

- [`vignette("getting-started")`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/articles/getting-started.md)
  introduces the cornerstone
  [`gtropic_data()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_data.md)
  function, running your first query, and how to navigate the resulting
  data.
- [`vignette("filtering")`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/articles/filtering.md)
  covers how all the spatio-temporal/storm filters in
  [`gtropic_data()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_data.md)
  combine, with a worked example.
- [`vignette("linkage")`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/articles/linkage.md)
  documents how to link precipitation/flood data to storm data and using
  the `links` table to perform joins without double-counting exposure
  rows.
- [`vignette("plotting")`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/articles/plotting.md)
  covers static and interactive maps, vectorized options, and
  publication-ready output.
- [`vignette("versions-and-caching")`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/articles/versions-and-caching.md)
  walks through reproducibility and download management best practices
  in `gtropic`.

## Citation

Please cite both the package and the underlying datasets. The dataset
DOIs and versions used by any given result are recorded in its manifest:

``` r

gtropic_manifest(usa_05)
```

# Package index

## Retrieval

The cornerstone data retrieval function and its associated helpers
accessing query metadata.

- [`gtropic_data()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_data.md)
  : Retrieve tropical cyclone exposure data from G-TROPIC
- [`gtropic_manifest()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_manifest.md)
  [`gtropic_filters()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_manifest.md)
  [`gtropic_warnings()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_manifest.md)
  [`gtropic_availability()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_manifest.md)
  : Extract metadata from a G-TROPIC result
- [`print(`*`<gtropic_data>`*`)`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/print.gtropic_data.md)
  : Print a G-TROPIC data result
- [`print(`*`<gtropic_filters>`*`)`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/print.gtropic_filters.md)
  : Print resolved G-TROPIC filters
- [`summary(`*`<gtropic_data>`*`)`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/summary.gtropic_data.md)
  : Summarize a G-TROPIC data result
- [`print(`*`<gtropic_manifest>`*`)`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/print.gtropic_manifest.md)
  : Print a G-TROPIC version manifest

## Discovery

Functions to explore the available administrative units, storms, years
and column definitions.

- [`gtropic_adm2()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_adm2.md)
  : List available second-level administrative units
- [`gtropic_storms()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_storms.md)
  : List available tropical cyclones
- [`gtropic_excluded_storms()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_excluded_storms.md)
  : List excluded tropical cyclones
- [`gtropic_years()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_years.md)
  : Report the temporal coverage of G-TROPIC
- [`gtropic_codebook()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_codebook.md)
  : Retrieve the G-TROPIC data codebook

## Cache

Optional, opt-in storage of downloaded files between R sessions.

- [`gtropic_cache_dir()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_dir.md)
  : Locate the G-TROPIC cache
- [`gtropic_cache_enable()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_enable.md)
  [`gtropic_cache_disable()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_enable.md)
  : Enable or disable caching
- [`gtropic_cache_list()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_list.md)
  [`gtropic_cache_size()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_list.md)
  : Inspect cached G-TROPIC files
- [`gtropic_cache_clear()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_clear.md)
  : Delete all cached G-TROPIC files
- [`gtropic_cache_prune()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_cache_prune.md)
  : Prune cached G-TROPIC files by size or age

## Plotting

Publication-ready static and interactive visualizations of locally
available G-TROPIC tables.

- [`gtropic_plot()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_plot.md)
  : Plot G-TROPIC data as static or interactive maps
- [`plot(`*`<gtropic_data>`*`)`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/plot.gtropic_data.md)
  : Plot a G-TROPIC retrieval result
- [`saffir_simpson()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/saffir_simpson.md)
  : Saffir-Simpson tropical-cyclone wind categories
- [`theme_gtropic()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/theme_gtropic.md)
  : Publication defaults for G-TROPIC plots
- [`scale_fill_gtropic_c()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/scale_fill_gtropic_c.md)
  [`scale_fill_gtropic_d()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/scale_fill_gtropic_c.md)
  : Color-blind-safe fill scales for G-TROPIC plots
- [`gtropic_basemap()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_basemap.md)
  : Natural Earth basemaps cached for the current R session
- [`gtropic_save()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_save.md)
  : Save a static plot

## Exposure metrics

Available published exposure metrics and their default plot
aggregations.

- [`gtropic_exposures()`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_exposures.md)
  : List G-TROPIC exposure metrics

## Configuration

Options controlling the server, dataset identifiers, timeouts and the
large query download guardrail.

- [`gtropic_options`](https://sparklabnyc.github.io/gtropic/reference/gtropic_options.md)
  : Options used by gtropic
